proof_body:
by
  intro A _ a
  have hk : RingHom.ker ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})).comp (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A))) = (Ideal.span {Polynomial.C a, Polynomial.X} : Ideal (Polynomial A)) := by
    ext f
    simp only [RingHom.mem_ker, RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, Ideal.mem_span_pair]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
      refine ⟨Polynomial.C c, Polynomial.divX f, ?_⟩
      have h1 := Polynomial.divX_mul_X_add f
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, hc, Polynomial.C_mul] at h1
      calc Polynomial.C c * Polynomial.C a + f.divX * Polynomial.X = f.divX * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.C c := by ring
        _ = f := h1
    · rintro ⟨g, h, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨g.eval 0, by simp; ring⟩
  have hs : Function.Surjective ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})).comp (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : A))) := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
    exact ⟨Polynomial.C x, by simp⟩
  exact ⟨(Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hk.symm).trans (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hs)⟩
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] (a : A), Nonempty ((Polynomial A ⧸ (Ideal.span {Polynomial.C a, Polynomial.X} : Ideal (Polynomial A))) ≃+* (A ⧸ Ideal.span {a}))
